articles.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre
articles.snippet: The court injunctions apply strictly to users within the AIFC and do not extend across the rest of Kazakhstan.

articles.title: Bitcoin extends bounce above $82,000 as stocks rebound, DeFi tokens lead altcoin gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose 0.8% to around $82,700 as China’s GDP beat estimates and Nasdaq futures rebounded, while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.3% and DeFi led gains.

articles.title: XRP 30-day exchange inflows pass 6B tokens as whales move to the sidelines
articles.snippet: More than 6 billion XRP reached exchanges tracked by CryptoQuant in the 30 days to Oct. 19, the most since March.

articles.title: Mt. Gox pushes creditor repayment deadline to 2027 in sixth extension
articles.snippet: Mt. Gox extended its repayment deadline by another year as some creditors remain unpaid due to incomplete procedures and payment processing issues.

articles.title: Bitget plans Thai crypto exchange acquisition weeks after $388M hack
articles.snippet: The proposed acquisition would give Bitget a route into Thailand’s crypto market through a locally licensed operator.
